description: On the countertop in front, there’s a small cardboard box near the back, a tiny rubber duck closer to the center, and a blue block off to the right. The right hand reaches in from the lower right, slides a small wooden cube toward the cardboard box and releases it inside, then reaches forward to the rubber duck to pick it up and remove it, and finally grasps the blue block and drags it along the counter toward the near edge.
